changelog: 🕒 Accurate Rhythm of Time Analytics: Replaced raw start/end slicing with exact unpaused focus intervals (getSessionActiveIntervals), eliminating pause time inflation in Reports

⚡ Real-Time Live Dashboard & Report Ticking: Dynamic per-second session calculation (liveTick) updates Dashboard focus minutes, today's totals, Day Log, Review, and Reports in real time without view switching

⌨️ Universal Markdown Top-Row Shortcuts & Smart Caret: Full support for top-row number keys (Ctrl+Shift+1/2/3/8/.), auto-focus on 'Write' toggle, and seamless caret positioning at end of document or top of blank notes

🎵 Robust Audio Feedback & Universal Break Offers: Web AudioContext auto-resumption ensures reliable audio cues on pause, resume, and stop across Focus, Popout, and bottom bar, with 1-click break offers (+5m / +15m) on manual stops

🖥️ Stealth Popout & Low-Resource System Tray: Floating popout completely hides the main window from the Alt+Tab task switcher; closing (X) cleanly minimizes to system tray with memory and V8 cache trimming

📱 Instant Android Lock Screen Notifications & Battery Conservation: 0ms immediate notification dispatch, VISIBILITY_PUBLIC bypass for OS 'hide sensitive content' setting, aesthetic text progress bar [██████░░░░] 60%, crisp monochrome status icon (ic_stat_lifelog), and battery-conserving background ticker
